page.overview:
What is Aolai?

The country lies east of the Flowers and Fruit Mountain, across 200 miles of water from the East Sea. In the country there is a king who has numberless men and soldiers in his city. There are all kinds of metalworks there. The city is filled with broad streets and huge marketplaces, countless houses and numerous arches. Under a clear sky and bright sun, people are coming and going constantly.

On suggestion of his advisors, Sun Wukong traveled quickly from the Flowers and Fruit Mountain on his Cloud Somersault to Aolai to obtain weapons for his monkey brethren to defend themselves with. He did so by summoning a harsh wind that caused all of Aolai's people to flee inside.
